description: The HISTORY of a project's calendar, newest first: every change of an event or of one of its occurrences — 'kind' (created, updated, deleted, occurrence, rollback), 'by' (the account), 'via' (the door: ui, api, mcp), 'source' and 'batch' (as the writer named them), 'at', and 'fields' — each field that changed with its value before and after (an occurrence changed apart is the field 'occ:20261123T150000Z'). With 'batches', the batches instead: how many changes and events each. Any member may read.

batch.description: Only the changes of this batch.

batches.description: true to list the batches instead of the changes.

before.description: Only changes older than this change id — the next page.

name: list_calendar_history
title: List calendar history
